title: Standing work, a test: iron at Garnet Belt (beyond the border, two jumps from The Experiment) into storage there
note: Written by Zero, 2026-11-17 03:17 UTC (orders.log ENT-025, block ZERO: iron for the reserve; rule F13: one ship and an empty hold until its first RESULT line). The field read 99,999 iron at richness 64 and 100,000 copper at 22 (census about 01:35 UTC), the richest iron within two jumps of a station of ours by the lanes table: Schedar and Ironhollow are the only fields one jump from one. Strangers met in the system in six hours: two ships of the faction tagged HEXC at Garnet Dim Lattice, never in combat (table met, 2026-11-16 23:34 UTC). Military hunts the veil rays of Garnet Dim Lattice, not this belt (admirals.log ENT-009). 2026-11-17 07:12 UTC (Zero, orders ENT-029, task 4 a): floor {"iron_ore": 30000} -> 20,000 iron, because the game says a depleted deposit refills gradually in proportion to its capacity (game/rules/13-not-stated.md, from mining.md), and our reads agree: Hamal grew back about 360 iron an hour at 31,000, Ironhollow Fading Signal 413 at 52,551, Echo Ejecta 312 near 97,000 (hive.py refill, read.db readings); a higher floor buys no faster regrowth, only a stock left for later, and iron is short 298,708 (the tool stock, view=reserve, 07:03 UTC). max_ships 1 -> 3, lift_to 10: three runs held (176 ore a run of 87 minutes, two jumps from The Experiment, -354 cr a ship-hour; no ship hurt); HEXC mining ships and one BUSY combat drone met here, none in combat (table met, 07:05 UTC). 2026-11-17 10:47 UTC (fill.py, Unity): max_ships 3 -> 4. 2026-11-17 11:05 UTC (fill.py, Unity): max_ships 4 -> 7.
